Name: Kore, Son of Asaph
Summary: Father of Meshelemiah the porter, of the sons of Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:1: Father of Meshelemiah the porter, of the sons of Asaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Kore in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
